title: VTG Culver Wall Drug & Mt Rushmore Gold Trim Shot Glass South Dakota Souvenir
descriptionText:
Add a classic South Dakota collectible to your display with this vintage Culver shot glass featuring Wall Drug on one side and Mount Rushmore on the other. The design includes elegant 22K-style gold trim (Culver’s signature style) and frosted/textured glass detailing.
Features:
• Vintage Culver glassware
• Wall Drug & Mt. Rushmore dual-sided design
• Gold-tone trim with textured frosted panels
• Clear, detailed graphics
• Excellent for collectors, display, or barware
Condition:
Pre-owned and in very good vintage condition. No chips or cracks. Light surface wear consistent with age. Please see photos for complete details.
